Case study 06 · BitGo · Branding & Design System

BitGo Branding and DesignSystem

Rebranded an engineering-run crypto custodian as a financial services company: site, design system and creative team, in under a year.

Scroll the story

Role

Creative Services Director; final approver on all design

Timeline

Under 1 year

Team

Built from zero: creative directors, developers, content and agencies

< 1 yrfrom rebrand brief to trade-show floor
1design system for marketing and product
0 → fullcreative team built from scratch

The short version

01

The problem

BitGo had the technology institutions wanted and an identity assembled by engineers. Its buyers, institutional crypto investors, were a market nobody had studied yet.

02

What I owned

Brand, website, content strategy and the design function, with budget and approval. Deadline: a trade-show reveal eight months out.

03

The approach

Recruited C-level finance users at trade shows after recruiting firms declined, got the knowledge out of the founders’ heads, and built one system for marketing and product.

04

The result

One brand and one design language from the booth to the transaction screen. BitGo stopped looking like a wallet vendor and started looking like a custodian.

The long version · for the detail-inclined

Detail

01 — Strategy

Strategy

Strategy

A Website and Content Ecosystem

While the Bitgo company had had a cryptocurrency wallet app for sometime, it was broadening its offerings to the larger new financial system and new and unfamiliar people. Abstract concepts needed a ton of explanation to customers and investors.

Strategy

A Website and Content Ecosystem

Concepts in digital asset custody and crypto currency required a rich symbolic language meant to communicate complicated and abstract ideas that are common to the finance / crypto world, but not usually covered anywhere outside of an economics class or brokerage firms.

02 — Research

Research

Research

Research

Looking at both Cryptocurrency wallets and traditional finance branding and design patterns we wanted to marry the two industries into a seamless blend.

Research

Research

Interviews with the founders and long time employees helped us collect the technical jargon and concepts that needed to be communicated.

Speaking with Former and Future clients also helped us customize that messaging in terms that they would understand.

05 — Results

Results

Results

What Did It Do?

Results:

  • Designed and implemented scalable design system for marketing and product
  • We built out full marketing ecosystem
  • A team was built from scratch to create all modules and components to use
  • True collaboration and cross influence with product to establish visual consistency and seamlessness
  • We documented and refined critical ideas and messages from the business for messaging and themes
  • Developed content strategy and messages for all channels
